notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
Improvements done with guns and with rifle : shells now falls from weapon and weapon are now animated.
When holding any objects, hands are now attached to the body.
Improvement of the phones in the oval office.
If an extinguisher is shot, or stabbed, it now becomes pierced and some gaz will get out of the hole.
Minor bugs corrections.

notes.title: Smashing time major update
notes.content:
[h2]A new level is available[/h2] 
You can now destroy everything in a school classroom.
The level also has some special objects, like the chalk, some basket balls, a frizbee.
[h2]New weapons to unlock[/h2]
A rocket launcher, a laser gun, a whip, a nunchaku, a shotgun
[h2]Performances improvements and bug fixes[/h2]
A major performance improvement effort was made on this version, in order to make the game run faster.
Inscrease of performances when burning objects
Possibility to switch from high quality to low quality in the menu
Bug fixes related to sound, and sound effects volumes
Crash related bug fixes
[h2]Physics improvements [/h2]
Improvement of the handling of many objects (better handling of pens, pencils, chalks, better handling of sledgehammer, ...).
Bullets now bounces on metal
Better poop physics to glue things with poo
[h2]Original levels update[/h2]
Added switches for lights
Added toilets to the oval office

notes.title: Major bug correction
notes.content:
Major performance improvement when many objects are broken
Guns improvement : gun will now make different damage depending on the material hit, and will now spawn feathers when pillow is shot.
Poop can now be used as glue in order to stick objects on the wall
Physics bugs with the fire extinguisher correction
Now there is a gun hidden in every level (and some grenades in the museum)
Sound improvement for poop collision
Added sounds for frowing/shrinking effects
Grenade physics improvement
Throwing objects velocity improvement
Poop traces have been improved

Minor performance improvements

Music is now shuffled on start
Fixed major performance issue in the restaurant
